title: Flory's Cottages & Camping

services.name: Campsites
services.desc: Clean, spacious, and ready to accommodate your next camping vacation, our campsites at Flory’s are pleasantly located and well-maintained to ensure the best possible camping experience for you and your family. We’re happy to provide you with any assistance you might need to set up camp! This is Lancaster County camping at its finest. Scenic views with some shade, and level, grassy sites with 30 or 50 amp electricity, water, sewer, cable TV, and Wi-Fi on all our campsites. Our rates are based on a family of 4 (2 adults and 2 children 4-17), one camping unit, and one vehicle per site.
